query:
SELECT
                    pt.id,
                    pt.download_id
                FROM pretranscodings pt
                    JOIN downloads d ON d.id = pt.download_id
                WHERE d.info_hash = $1
                    AND d.file_idx = $2
                    AND pt.only_audio = $3
                    AND pt.audio_index = $4
                    AND pt.status = 'completed'
                LIMIT 1
